title: Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA): Antibribery & Accounting Provisions (15 U.S.C. 78dd-1)
text:
It is unlawful for any issuer or associated person to make use of interstate commerce corruptly in furtherance of an offer, payment, promise to pay, or authorization of the giving of anything of value to any foreign official, intermediary, or partner to secure any improper advantage.
Issuers must maintain accurate books, records, and internal accounting controls to prevent concealed related-party benefits, slush funds, or unrecorded kickbacks.
